actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches a login prompt, and block until it is ready.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process attached to /app/alpine.iso
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background and remain running
Connecting with telnet to 127.0.0.1 6665 must present a login prompt
The task is complete only once readiness is demonstrated by receipt-backed evidence
known_invalid_patterns: Starting QEMU without exposing telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665
Non-functional smoke checks that do not prove the login prompt is reachable
Stopping after launch without waiting for readiness
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and environment for qemu/telnet support
Launch QEMU with a serial/monitor configuration that exposes a telnet server on port 6665
Verify the port is listening and that telnet reaches the login prompt
Keep the VM running in the background
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed command output showing QEMU launch command and background PID
Receipt-backed telnet/session output showing the login prompt

plan.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches a login prompt, and block until it is ready.
plan.current_focus: Discover available tooling and launch QEMU with telnet-accessible console.
implementation_approach: Inspect environment for qemu and telnet-related tools
Start QEMU in background with a serial console exposed on TCP port 6665
Wait until the service is reachable and the login prompt is observable
validation_strategy: Connect via telnet and observe the login prompt
verification_test_strategy: Use raw_bash to inspect binaries and run QEMU
Use telnet or equivalent client to verify prompt reachability
known_bad_behavior: Stopping before the VM is reachable
Using a port/configuration that does not expose a login prompt
evidence_gaps: No evidence yet that qemu is installed
No evidence yet that the VM can be launched with telnet on 6665
No evidence yet of a login prompt
risks: QEMU may be missing or require alternate invocation
The ISO may need specific boot parameters or console settings
next_steps: Probe for qemu and telnet-related tools
Launch the VM with the correct console redirection
Verify readiness and keep it running

actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-kvm || true
command -v telnet || command -v nc || command -v socat || true
ls -l /app/alpine.iso
